items.caption: This modern oracle-script redraw represents a form catalogued as 去. The graph’s interpretation is disputed: one account reads a person leaving an opening, while another identifies a covered vessel associated with 盍; the form alone does not settle the dispute.
items.alt: Modern vector redraw of a Shang oracle-script form catalogued as 去.
items.selection_reason: It represents the early graph at the center of competing readings. The caption avoids relying on an unverified description of its pixel-level shape.
items.rights: The Commons page states that the redraw is public domain; it separately states that the underlying Sinica Database image is CC0 1.0.

items.period: Shuowen small-seal script tradition; Han-dynasty lexicographic form tradition
items.tradition: Shuowen seal script; modern vector redraw
items.caption: This modern redraw represents the Shuowen seal-script form of 去. Shuowen explains the character as people parting and parses it as 大 plus phonetic 凵; another analysis disputes that parsing, so the later form does not settle the identity of the earlier graph.
items.alt: Modern vector redraw of 去 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: It provides a later form and the historical lexicographic explanation for comparison with the disputed early graph.
items.rights: The Commons page gives a public-domain statement for the SVG representation and separately states that the underlying Sinica Database image is CC0 1.0.
